description:
## Functional specifications
Extend existing DS components: connector/channel/thread information and author attribution; People access grouped by connector with manual/provider origins and capability-gated refresh. No strategy selector. Use Event/NodeRouter and trusted admin context. Test nil/legacy projections, long/escaped IDs, unauthorized refresh and unsupported/unavailable capability distinctions. Recheck existing labels against the canonical transcript model. Final UX approval still precedes new E2E authoring.

## Files and ownership
lib/zaq_web/history/{conversation_row,conversation_context}.ex; components/design_system/conversation_detail.ex; BO history/detail LiveViews/tests

## Action reuse assessment
Display existing authorized projection through existing DS components. No new Action for presentation. This child owns history UI only, not People access. Preserve People projection compatibility.

## Tests to add before implementation / branches
Use the explicit scenarios in Functional specifications as acceptance tests; include denial, failure, concurrency and idempotency branches where applicable. Preserve existing passing assertions.

## Mocking plan
External transport/model/clock boundaries only; no blanket NodeRouter stubs.

## Documentation
DESIGN.md and docs/bo-components.md guide implementation; update applicable user guide/Storybook

Execution requirements: planning only until assigned for implementation. Preserve existing uncommitted work and progress comments; do not infer completion from historical tests. Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md and applicable service guides before affected work. Write immediate unit/integration/property regression tests BEFORE implementation. Mock only genuine external boundaries; keep internal domain paths real. Run isolated tests and mix q per issue; final precommit belongs to the dedicated final gate. New feature E2E authoring waits for zaq-emb.12. No commit/push authorization is implied.

comments.text: Human approved extending existing BO history list/detail UI without separate prototype; reuse existing design system, obtain final UX approval before new E2E.

BO display-only stage does not require shared transcript rewrite; remove previous dependency on .3. Recheck after scope migration. Human approved extending existing components directly.

BO history list/detail now show connector ID, external channel ID, Thread ID or Channel-level, with missing/legacy fallbacks and escaping; reuse existing Table/ConversationDetail. Test-first: 24 component/LiveView tests passed. Browser inspection on localhost:4010 blocked by Phoenix PendingMigrationError; do not apply dev migrations yet because user said 768 migrations remain unconsumed until final shape. mix q initially reports alias style, corrected, subsequent retry hit intermittent ExDNA.Credo internal 5s timeout; retry when host load clears. UX approval/E2E remains open.

Post-fix mix q passed with no Credo findings. Combined relevant permission/merge/status/BO test run: 108 tests, 6 properties, 0 failures. Browser inspection attempted at localhost:4010 but blocked by pending unconsumed migration; do not run dev migration until shared scope is finalized. No UI approval requested yet; People UI still pending.
